demoBanner: Demo data: everything on this site is made up.
homeIntro: This is a proof of concept of the church website and members area.
signinIntro: Enter your email address and we will send you a link to sign in. There is no password.
signinSent: If that address belongs to a member who can sign in, a link is on its way. It works once and expires soon.
signinLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
signinInvalid: That does not look like an email address. Please check it and try again.
signinConfirmBody: Select the button to sign in on this device.
signinBadLinkBody: The link has expired, has already been used, or is not valid. Ask for a new one.
signinEmailBody:
Hello,

Use this link to sign in to {{site}}:

{{url}}

It works once and expires in {{minutes}} minutes. If you did not ask for it, you can ignore this email.
outboxIntro: Nothing here was sent. This is every email the fake sender has been given since the server started.
eventRegularServiceHelp: Sunday class and worship, Wednesday class. In the calendar feeds, but not posted to Facebook or listed in the bulletin unless cancelled or changed.
eventPublicHelp: On means anyone can see it, in the public feed and on Facebook. Off means members only.
eventAnnounceFromHelp: The first day this is announced on Facebook and in the bulletin. Leave blank for 14 days before the event.
eventNotifyFacebookHelp: For a regular service: tick to post when this one is cancelled or moved.
eventRepeatNthWeekday: Monthly on the same weekday (for example the first Sunday)
eventMembersOnly: This event is for members only.
calSubscribeIntro: Add the church calendar to the calendar on your phone or computer. It updates by itself when something changes.
calPublicHelp: Public events only. Anyone can use this link.
calMemberHelp: Includes members-only events. This link is private to you: do not share it.
calMemberLinkOnce: Here is your new link. Copy it now: it is not shown again.
calMemberOn: You have a private link. For safety it is not shown again; make a new one if you need it.
calMemberOff: Your private link is turned off.
calMemberNone: You do not have a private link yet.
calMemberReplace: Make a new link (the old one stops working)
searchLabel: Search by name, street or phone
searchHelp: Search finds a household whichever layout you are using.
layoutSwitchToList: Show as an A to Z list
notFoundBody: We could not find that household.
notAllowedBody: You can edit your own household. Ask the office to change anyone else.
householdOptedOut: This household asked not to be listed. Only the office sees it.
householdNoAdults: This household has no adults, so only the office can edit it.
editIntroMember: Change your household details. The office sees every change.
editIntroOffice: You are editing as the office. Every change is recorded.
editErrors: Some answers need fixing. They are marked below.
autoName: Work the name out from the people
homePhoneHint: Leave empty if there is none.
optOutLabel: Do not list this household in the directory
dobHint: Members see the day and month only.
dobHintOffice: Members see the day and month only. The office sees the year.
minorContactHint: Children show name and birthday only, so this is for the office.
minorEmailHint: Children show name and birthday only, so this is for the office.
ownEmailHint: This is also the address used to sign in.
emailHint: Used to sign in. Change it only if you are sure.
hideCellphone: Hide this cell phone from other members
hideEmail: Hide this email from other members
hideAddress: Hide the address from other members
askOfficeToAdd: To add or remove someone, ask the office.
errorDateOfBirth: Enter a real date of birth.
errorEmail: That does not look like an email address.
errorEmailTaken: Another person already uses that email address.
pdfFooterLeft: {{church}} · For members only. Please do not share or post this list.
tasksNotKept: No list was kept for this week.
tasksTemplateIntro: These tasks start every week. A change starts from the week of
tasksTemplatePending: A change is already waiting for next week. Saving again replaces it. This week's list is not touched; add anything needed now as a one-off task.
tasksTemplateBlankHint: Fill in a blank row to add a task.
awayIntro: Mark the dates when someone in this household can't serve. Only the office and the roster coordinator see them.
awayToHelp: Leave "To" blank for a single day.
rosterIndexIntro: Choose a month to suggest, adjust and publish its roster.
rosterNotPublished: This month is not published yet.
rosterSuggestedHelp: This is a suggestion and is not saved yet. Adjust it, then save a draft or publish.
rosterDraftHelp: Adjust it, then publish to email the roster.
rosterPublishedHelp: Changing a slot below emails only the two people it affects.
rosterSwapButton: Save swaps and email the people affected
rosterMailResult: Email: {{sent}} sent, {{refused}} not sent (the address is not on the send-allowlist).
rosterNoAway: Nobody is marked away this month.
rosterEmailBody:
Hello,

Here is the servers roster for {{month}} at {{site}}.

{{mine}}{{list}}

If you can't serve, please tell the office.
rosterSwapOutBody:
Hello {{name}},

You are no longer down for {{role}} ({{when}}). Thank you.
rosterSwapInBody:
Hello {{name}},

You are now down for {{role}} ({{when}}). If you can't, please tell the office.
